import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final int size = 5;
        int[] arr = new int[size];
        int n, sum = 0;
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = scanner.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            arr[i] = scanner.nextInt();
            sum = sum + arr[i];
        }
        System.out.println(sum / n);
    }
}
